response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but their profile does not match this role's core requirements. Their only professional C++ experience was a ~7-month engagement at National Instruments in 2014–2015, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. They also lack fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was fintech-adjacent but focused on Node/TypeScript legal-entity tooling, not trading or fixed-income systems), and there is no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle depth.
strengths: Strong low-latency/systems experience (DLang async I/O services handling millions of requests/sec)
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development, DevOps tooling
Broad polyglot background with SQL, Java, and scripting exposure covering several desirable skills
concerns: Minimal professional C++ experience (~7 months in 2014–2015), versus 5–10 years required
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development depth; recent work is web/TypeScript-centric

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain
Strong systems and performance engineering fundamentals
